zh-TW: 不動產廠房及設備週轉率

definition.zh-TW:
每一元的不動產、廠房及設備在一段期間內做出多少營業收入。

它衡量廠房設備的使用效率：設備閒置或剛大量添購時，這個比率會下降。
definition.en:
How much revenue each unit of property, plant and equipment generates during a period.

It measures how productively plant and equipment are used: the ratio falls when capacity sits idle or right after a large purchase.

example.zh-TW: 分子來自損益表，分母來自資產負債表的固定資產區。公司完全沒有設備時分母為 0，顯示 N/A。教材部分頁面稱它為固定資產週轉率，是舊稱。
example.en: The numerator comes from the income statement and the denominator from the fixed assets section of the balance sheet. A company with no equipment has a zero denominator and shows N/A. Some course pages call it fixed asset turnover, an older name.

misconception.zh-TW: 用設備的原始成本當分母。課程版面顯示的是扣掉累計折舊後的淨額，比率要用淨額計算；用毛額會讓老舊設備多的公司看起來效率偏低。
misconception.en: Using the original cost of the equipment as the denominator. The course layout shows the net amount after accumulated depreciation and the ratio uses that; using gross cost would make companies with older equipment look less efficient.

formula.zh-TW: 不動產、廠房及設備週轉率 ＝ 營業收入 ÷ 不動產、廠房及設備淨額。課程版用期末淨額（課程版面只有機器設備一列）；年報版用平均淨額。
formula.en: Property, plant and equipment turnover = revenue ÷ net property, plant and equipment. The course version uses the closing net amount (the course layout has only the machinery line); the annual report version uses the average.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率，這個名稱是國際通用的說法；計算口徑以指標登錄檔的版本為準，題目會指定用哪一個版本計分。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios; the name follows international usage. The calculation basis is the version in the ratio registry, and each question states which version it scores against.
